## Review

**7 out of 10, Effective.** Presentation quality, judged with the SlideDeck Co review heuristic (https://slidedeck.co/review-methodology/). The ask, the evidence and the merit of the idea are not rated.

The main section (slides 4 to 26) is a competent investor deck. Slides 4, 6 and 22 use full-sentence action titles, a consistent chart-plus-commentary layout and a restrained orange and grey palette, so the audience can see growth, margin and guidance quickly. The route is logical: headline results, priority brands, pipeline readouts, financial review and guidance, conclusions, then the investor event. The weaknesses are consequential. Slide 6 has very small chart axes, labels and legends with weak competitor differentiation, and slides 4 and 22 leave large empty bands under the titles. The appendix from about slide 27 onward is a long run of near-identical text-only trial tables set in tiny type (slides 30 to 36 and 39 to 72), which is reference material that is hard to read on screen.

**Worth keeping:** The action titles, the consistent brand layout with the left navigation and section tags, and the restrained orange highlight for the key series on slides 4, 6 and 22.

**Most useful repair:** Enlarge the chart text and simplify the NBRx lines on slide 6, close the empty space under the titles on slides 4 and 22, and make the tiny pipeline tables on slides 30 to 36 legible.

**What would change the score:** Cut or consolidate the repetitive clinical-trial appendix into a readable reference format with highlighted key fields, and add a stronger visual for the slide 14 readout outcomes.

_Confidence medium. 72 of 91 pages inspected on contact sheets, 4 at readable size. Reviewed Reviewed 2026-11-08. Model-assisted review (claude-sonnet-5-5)._

## Summary

The deck is Novartis's Q3 2026 results investor presentation, dated October 27, 2026, and presented by CEO Vas Narasimhan and CFO Mukul Mehta. It opens with a title slide and a forward-looking statements disclaimer, then moves through a sequence of sections: company overview, financial review, innovation and pipeline, conclusions, and a large appendix. The company overview covers Q3 sales growth, core margin expansion, and sales tables for priority brands such as Kisqali, Kesimpta, Pluvicto, Leqvio, Scemblix, Cosentyx and Rhapsido, each with a slide of quarterly charts and market-share commentary. The financial review presents key figures, capital allocation, the raised full-year core operating income guidance, a quarterly growth outlook and a currency impact slide. The innovation section reports readouts for remibrutinib, del-desiran and pelacarsen, followed by a pipeline overview and a detailed appendix of clinical trial summaries. The deck closes with conclusions and an upcoming investor event. Slides worth studying include the Q3 headline summary, which pairs bar charts with a short list of pipeline highlights, and the Kisqali slide, which combines a monthly NBRx trend line with a competitor comparison.

## Questions about this deck

**How many slides or pages does the Novartis Q3 2026 results investor presentation have?**

The deck has 91 pages in total. Slide 1 is the title slide and opens with a navigation menu listing Company overview, Financial review, Conclusions, Appendix and References.

**What did Novartis report for Kisqali sales growth in Q3 2026?**

Kisqali Q3 sales grew +37% cc, with Q3 2026 sales of 1,821 USD million. Slide 6 also notes that US sales were up +38% in Q3 and that Kisqali is the eBC market leader in the US.

**What is the Novartis FY 2026 core operating income guidance after the Q3 update?**

Novartis upgraded its FY 2026 core operating income guidance to be in line to grow low single-digit. Slide 4 gives this guidance, and it refers to the detailed assumptions on slide 21.

**What did Novartis report for remibrutinib in the Q3 2026 innovation readouts?**

Slide 14 states that the primary endpoint was met in both Phase III REMODEL-1 and REMODEL-2 trials in RMS, significantly reducing ARR versus teriflunomide. The slide also says the FDA submission is expected in Q4 with a priority review voucher.

### Slide 4

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: Opens the financial story with a single headline sentence and paired before-and-after bar charts for sales and core operating income, making the key numbers readable at a glance.
- Review: The main section (slides 4 to 26) is a competent investor deck.
- Review: Slides 4, 6 and 22 use full-sentence action titles, a consistent chart-plus-commentary layout and a restrained orange and grey palette, so the audience can see growth, margin and guidance quickly.
- Review: Slide 6 has very small chart axes, labels and legends with weak competitor differentiation, and slides 4 and 22 leave large empty bands under the titles.
- Worth keeping: The action titles, the consistent brand layout with the left navigation and section tags, and the restrained orange highlight for the key series on slides 4, 6 and 22.
- Suggested repair: Enlarge the chart text and simplify the NBRx lines on slide 6, close the empty space under the titles on slides 4 and 22, and make the tiny pipeline tables on slides 30 to 36 legible.

### Slide 6

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: Combines a monthly line chart of US eBC new-to-brand prescriptions with side-by-side market and competitor comparisons, showing how a line chart and regional panels can be used together.
- Review: Slides 4, 6 and 22 use full-sentence action titles, a consistent chart-plus-commentary layout and a restrained orange and grey palette, so the audience can see growth, margin and guidance quickly.
- Review: Slide 6 has very small chart axes, labels and legends with weak competitor differentiation, and slides 4 and 22 leave large empty bands under the titles.
- Worth keeping: The action titles, the consistent brand layout with the left navigation and section tags, and the restrained orange highlight for the key series on slides 4, 6 and 22.
- Suggested repair: Enlarge the chart text and simplify the NBRx lines on slide 6, close the empty space under the titles on slides 4 and 22, and make the tiny pipeline tables on slides 30 to 36 legible.

**Layout**

Left navigation sidebar (about 13% wide) with back/forward arrows, 'Content' heading and five menu items. Title spans the top of the main area, left-aligned. A grey panel at left (sales evolution stacked bar chart plus two line charts) sits beside a right-hand text column with two bold headed bullet groups and a callout. Footnote line below the panel, Novartis logo bottom left, footer text and page number bottom right, GROWTH tab at top right.

**Visuals**

Left sidebar: two circular outline icons with left and right arrows at top-left. 'Company overview' row is highlighted with light grey fill and a vertical blue-to-orange gradient bar on its left edge; thin separator lines between menu items. Top right: dark grey tab with rounded bottom-left corner containing GROWTH. Chart panel: light grey (#F2F2F2) panel with a thin vertical gradient strip on its left edge (pale blue at top to orange at bottom). Stacked bar chart 'Sales evolution' with legend (dark grey square US, mid grey square Ex-US). Two bars on a black baseline: Q3 2025 total 1,329 (US 844 dark grey #414140 bottom, Ex-US 485 mid grey #6D6E6C top); Q3 2026 total 1,821 (US 1,168, Ex-US 653). A bracket line connects above the Q3 2025 bar to an oval labelled +37% with an arrow pointing down to the 1,821 total. A thin vertical divider separates it from two dotted line charts. Top chart 'US eBC NBRx1': y-axis 0% to 80%, x-axis monthly Sep-24 to Aug-26 with rotated labels; orange Kisqali series rises from about 22% to about 60%; dark grey Competitor 1 near 5% flat; grey Competitor 2 falls from about 72% to about 37%. Legend with orange, dark grey and grey dotted markers. Bottom chart 'DE eBC NBRx2': y-axis 0% to 100%, x-axis Oct-24 to Jun-26 labels every two months; orange Kisqali rises from about 42% to about 80%; Competitor 2 falls from about 57% to about 20%; Competitor 1 near 3%. A thin horizontal rule above the NATALEE callout, an orange chevron arrow left of the callout. Novartis logo (flame-like symbol and serif wordmark) bottom left.

US: +21% cc in Q3
• TRx growth¹ outpacing the market, +3%pts in MS (~16% share) and +4.5%pts in B-cell class (~27% share) vs. PY
• Continuing to be prescribed earlier in therapy, with 77% of NBRx’s 1L or 1st switch
Ex-US: +23% cc in Q3
• Strong growth in Europe, treating ~1/6 MS patients²
• ~80% of EU4³ patients from 1L or 1st switch
Continued evidence generation highlighted at MSToronto
• STHENOS (Phase IIIb study) supports 1L initiation of Kesimpta in mildly active patients
• ALITHIOS (OLE study) shows sustained high efficacy and a consistent safety and tolerability profile over 8 years
• KATHAROS (prospective OL breastfeeding study) supports treatment decisions for women with MS
• NEOS (Phase III study) broadens the evidence base in paediatric MS

**Layout**

Left navigation sidebar (about 13% wide) with back/forward arrows and a menu of five items. Wide title at top-left of the main area, a GROWTH tab at top right. Below the title is a grey panel (left ~54% width) split into a stacked bar chart on the left and two line charts stacked on the right; a bullet text column sits to the right of the panel. Footnote text runs below the panel, Novartis logo at bottom left, footer text and page number at bottom right.

**Visuals**

Sidebar: two small circular outline icons with left and right arrows at top-left; the active menu item 'Company overview' has a light grey highlight band with a vertical blue-to-orange gradient strip on its left edge; thin separator lines between menu items. GROWTH tab: dark grey rounded-left tab at the top right edge. Grey chart panel with a thin vertical gradient strip on the left edge (light blue at top to orange at bottom). Stacked bar chart 'Sales evolution' (USD m, % cc), with legend squares dark grey for US and mid grey for Ex-US. Q3 2025 bar: US 233 (dark), Ex-US 125 (mid grey), total 358. Q3 2026 bar: US 414, Ex-US 179, total 593. A bracket line from the 358 bar goes up and across through an oval labelled +67% to an arrowhead pointing down at 593. Baseline under the bars. A thin vertical divider separates the bar chart from the line charts. US 1L NBRx Share (R3M) line chart: monthly Jan-25 to Jun-26 on x-axis with rotated labels; legend of Competitor 1 (black), Competitor 2 (dark grey), Competitor 3 (mid grey), Competitor 4 (light grey), Competitor 5 (very light grey), Scemblix (orange). The orange line rises from 17% to 24%, 25%, 32%, 30% and 33%, ending above the others. JP 1L NBRx Share (Quarterly) line chart: Q4'24 to Q2'26; Competitor 1 black line falls from the top-left to 27 then 19; competitors 2-4 grey lines decline to 14 and 15; the orange Scemblix line rises from 18 to 45, 50, 49 and 56, with a small bracket near 49. Bullet lists with round bullets on the right. Novartis logo: a stylised flame-like mark with the NOVARTIS serif wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid #FCFCFC with a white-to-near-white content area. Off-white background #FCFCFC, near-white main area. Titles and headings in near-black #161616, bold Arial-like sans-serif; title about 3.8% of slide height; panel headings 2.5%; body bullets 1.9% in black regular Arial. Orange accent #FF4E00 for Scemblix lines and labels. Bars dark grey #414241 and mid grey #6D6E6D; chart panel fill #F2F2F2. Sidebar text in Volta Modern, about 1.3%. GROWTH tab dark grey with white text. No shadows; the tab has a rounded corner.

**Layout**

Left navigation sidebar (about 13% wide) with back/forward arrows, 'Content' heading and five menu items. **Visuals**

Stacked bar chart 'Sales evolution' (USD m, % cc) with two bars: Q3 2025 (US 1,005 dark grey, Ex-US 693 mid grey, total 1,698) and Q3 2026 (US 1,093, Ex-US 764, total 1,857). A bracket line with an arrow from the first total to the second carries an oval labelled +9%. Legend squares: US dark grey, Ex-US mid grey. Line chart 'US HS Naive NBRx Share (R4W)': y axis 0-60%, x axis Aug-25 to Aug-26; Cosentyx orange line at about 47-52% with labels 50%, 49%, 48%, 52%, 48%, 47%, 48%; Competitor 1 black line about 20-34%, Competitor 2 dark grey line about 18-31%. Line chart 'US SpA IV Patient Share': y axis 0-60%, x axis Jul-24 to Jul-26 (bimonthly); Competitor 2 dark grey about 49-55% ending 49%, Competitor 1 black about 33-37% ending 33%, Cosentyx orange rising from about 4% to 14%, Competitor 3 light grey about 4%. Left sidebar has circular arrow icons, a highlighted 'Company overview' row with a blue-to-orange gradient bar at its left edge. A vertical gradient strip (light blue to orange) on the left edge of the grey panel. Thin vertical divider between the bar chart and the line charts. Novartis logo with flame symbol. Dark grey 'GROWTH' tab with a rounded lower-left corner.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #FCFCFC. Off-white background #FCFCFC, light grey panel #F2F2F2 for charts. Title bold Arial-style sans-serif near-black #161616, about 3.8% of slide height; headings bold about 2.5%; body regular about 1.9%. Accent orange #FF4E00 for Cosentyx lines. Bars dark #414241 and #6D6E6D. Sidebar text in Volta-like sans-serif, black, small. GROWTH tab dark grey #414241 with white text. No shadows.

He wears a dark navy blazer over a light blue textured open-collar shirt. Head and shoulders framing, soft studio lighting, dark slate blue-grey mottled backdrop, cropped to a tall rectangle from the right edge to about 51% of the slide width. ### Slide 22

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: Uses an illustrative quarterly growth chart to show how second-half acceleration is framed against the full-year guidance, a clear way to present a forecast without implying certainty.
- Review: Slides 4, 6 and 22 use full-sentence action titles, a consistent chart-plus-commentary layout and a restrained orange and grey palette, so the audience can see growth, margin and guidance quickly.
- Review: Slide 6 has very small chart axes, labels and legends with weak competitor differentiation, and slides 4 and 22 leave large empty bands under the titles.
- Worth keeping: The action titles, the consistent brand layout with the left navigation and section tags, and the restrained orange highlight for the key series on slides 4, 6 and 22.
- Suggested repair: Enlarge the chart text and simplify the NBRx lines on slide 6, close the empty space under the titles on slides 4 and 22, and make the tiny pipeline tables on slides 30 to 36 legible.

**Layout**

Left navigation sidebar (about 13% wide) with back/forward arrow icons and a contents menu. **Visuals**

Tables in two columns, each section with a bold heading and an orange (about #F26A21) rule beneath, then a header row (Code, Name, Mechanism, Indication(s)) with thin grey separator lines. Legend: a small light grey square with the label 'Lead indication'. Sidebar: two circled arrow icons (left and right arrows) at top left; a light grey highlight block behind the Appendix group, with a thin vertical gradient bar (light blue-lilac fading to orange) at the far left edge. The 'INNOVATION' tab is a dark grey rounded-corner tab at top right with white text. Novartis logo: grey flame/'U' symbol with NOVARTIS serif wordmark at bottom left.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #FCFCFC. Off-white background #FCFCFC, with the main content panel #FFFFFF/#FCFCFC and the sidebar slightly differentiated by a thin vertical divider. Titles in near-black #161616 bold Arial sans-serif (title about 3.8% of slide height); section headings bold about 1.6%; table text Arial regular about 1.14% in black #000000. Orange accent rules #F26A21. Sidebar text in Volta Modern (sans-serif), with the active item bold. Dark grey tab #4D4D4D with white text. Grey highlights #D9D9D9 for lead indications. No shadows.

**Layout**

Navigation circle arrow icons (left, right) at top-left of sidebar. Dark grey tab with rounded bottom-left corner top right. Legend of five outlined boxes with icons: CRM (heart), Immunology (antibody Y), Neuroscience (brain), Oncology (gear/cell), Non-core TA project (grey, no icon). Year header bars with horizontal gradients: 2026 light blue (#C5D6EC), 2027 blue to pinkish lilac, 2028 pinkish mauve (#DDB8C4), ≥2029 pink to orange-red (#FF6A2B). Each pipeline card is a white box with thin dark grey outline, bold drug name, tiny code and indication, and a line icon on the right (heart for CRM, Y-antibody for immunology, brain for neuroscience, gear for oncology). Grey-text cards with light grey outline and no icon: ganaplacide + lumefantrine, cipargamin (severe), LXE408, cipargamin¹. Vertical black lines flank the rotated 'Lead' label; a short vertical line sits above 'Supplementary'. Sidebar active section Appendix has a light grey highlight and a coloured blue-to-orange vertical gradient strip at its left edge. Novartis logo is a flame/flask-like mark with the NOVARTIS wordmark in serif capitals.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #FCFCFC with sidebar and thin vertical divider. Near-white background #FCFCFC, sidebar slightly off-white with active band #F5F5F5. Titles and text near-black #161616; sans-serif Arial bold for title (about 3.8% of slide height) and Arial regular for subtitle (2.85%). Card names Arial bold about 1.26%, codes and indications Arial about 0.8%. Sidebar uses Volta Modern sans-serif. Accents: dark grey tab #333333 with white text, gradient header bars blue to orange. Thin 1px grey card outlines (#555555), square corners, no shadows.

**Layout**

Left navigation sidebar (about 13% wide) with document menu; main area has a left-aligned title and subtitle at top, a legend row of five therapeutic-area boxes at the upper right, then a timeline grid of four year columns (2026, 2027, 2028, ≥2029) with stacked product cards, a vertical 'Existing brands' label at left of the grid, footnotes below, Novartis logo bottom left, footer text and page number bottom right, and an INNOVATION tab at top right.

**Visuals**

Sidebar has two circular outline arrow buttons (left and right) at top left; the 'Appendix' section is highlighted by a light grey panel with a thin blue-to-orange gradient strip at the far left edge. Dark grey tab 'INNOVATION' with rounded bottom-left corner at top right. Legend of five outlined boxes with icons: CRM (heart outline), Immunology (antibody Y icon), Neuroscience (brain icon), Oncology (gear/cell icon), Non-core TA project (grey text, no icon). Year header bars: 2026 light blue (#C5D5EA), 2027 blue-lilac fading to pink, 2028 pink-mauve (#DDB8C6), ≥2029 wide bar gradient from pink (#E8A8A8) to bright orange (#FF6A2D). Thin vertical black lines above and below the rotated 'Existing brands' label. Product cards are white rectangles with thin grey outline, each with name in bold, generic name, indication in small text, and a right-side icon. 2026 column: Cosentyx (antibody icon), Kesimpta (brain), Rhapsido (antibody). 2027 column: Fabhalta (brain), Kesimpta (brain), Leqvio (heart), Mayzent (brain), Rhapsido HS (antibody), Scemblix (gear), Rhapsido CSU (antibody). 2028: Lutathera (gear). ≥2029 first column: Fabhalta aHUS (gear), Pluvicto (gear), Vijoice (gear), Scemblix (gear); second column: Fabhalta IC-MPGN (heart), Leqvio primary prevention (heart); third column: Rhapsido FA (antibody), Rhapsido CPUO (antibody). Bottom row of faded grey cards (non-core): Rydapt (2027), Aimovig (2028), Adakveo, Atectura, Enerzair Breezhaler (≥2029), with grey text and grey outline. Novartis logo: flame/drop symbol with serif wordmark NOVARTIS in dark grey.

**Design**

Background: Near-white #FCFCFC with a #F5F5F5 highlight panel behind the sidebar Appendix section. Clean corporate light look: near-white background #FCFCFC, sidebar slightly off-white with divider lines. Titles in black-charcoal #161616 bold Arial-style sans-serif (title about 3.8% of slide height, subtitle regular about 2.9%). Card text black, bold product names about 1.25% height, small details about 0.8%. Sidebar in Volta Modern-like sans-serif at about 1.3%. Grey #7F7F7F for non-core items. Accent gradient blue to pink to orange. Thin 1px grey card outlines, no shadows, square corners.

Novartis logo bottom-left; footer text and page number bottom-right.

Two circular outline arrow buttons (left and right arrows) at top-left of sidebar. Thin grey divider lines between sidebar menu items and a vertical grey line at the sidebar edge. Two tables with an orange rule under each table heading and thin light-grey horizontal row separators. Novartis logo (flame/swirl icon plus serif wordmark NOVARTIS) at bottom-left.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #FCFCFC. Off-white #FCFCFC background, sidebar in white with grey separators. Title and table labels in near-black #161616 bold Arial; body values in black Arial regular. Sidebar uses Volta Modern (geometric sans) in black, with medium weight for the active items. Accent orange #E8601C for the heading rules and the gradient strip. Indication
Food allergy
Phase
Phase 3
Patients
576
Primary Outcome Measures
Sub-study 1: Number of participants achieving response status (tolerated at least 600 mg of peanut protein)
Sub-study 2: Number of participants achieving response status (tolerated at least 1000 mg of milk protein)
Sub-study 3: Number of participants achieving response status (tolerated at least 1000 mg of egg protein)
Arms Intervention
1) Experimental: Sub-study 1- LOU064: Participants with peanut allergy will receive remibrutinib during the double-blind treatment period (up to Week 24),
2) Placebo Comparator: Sub-study 1- Placebo: Participants with peanut allergy will receive matching placebo during the double-blind treatment period (up to Week 24)
3) Experimental: Sub-study 2- LOU064: Participants with cow's milk allergy will receive remibrutinib during the double-blind treatment period (up to Week 24)
4) Placebo Comparator: Sub-study 2- Placebo: Participants with cow's milk allergy will receive matching placebo during the double-blind treatment period (up to Week 24)
5) Experimental: Sub-study 3- LOU064: Participants with hen's egg allergy will receive remibrutinib during the double-blind treatment period (up to Week 24)
6) Placebo Comparator: Sub-study 3- Placebo: Participants with hen's egg allergy will receive matching placebo during the double-blind treatment period (up to Week 24)
7) Experimental: Sub-study 4- LOU064: Participants with peanut, cow's milk, and hen's egg allergy will receive remibrutinib during the double-blind treatment period (up to Week 4)
8) Placebo Comparator: Sub-study 4- Placebo: Participants with peanut, cow's milk, and hen's egg allergy will receive matching placebo during the double-blind treatment period (up to Week 4)
All arms are followed by open-label remibrutinib treatment through Week 52.
Target Patients
Adolescent and adult participants with peanut, milk, or egg IgE-mediated allergy.
Readout Milestone(s)
2029
Publication
TBD

Two borderless two-column tables (label column bold, value column regular) separated by thin light grey horizontal row lines, each with an orange (#F26B3A) rule under its heading. The Novartis logo is a flame/droplet-like emblem with the serif wordmark NOVARTIS in dark text, bottom-left.

**Design**

Title in near-black #161616 bold Arial, about 2.5% of slide height. Table headings bold Arial about 1.7%. Table body Arial 1.4%, labels bold #161616 and values regular black. Sidebar text in Volta Modern (sans-serif), black, in medium weight for the active items. Accent orange #F26B3A for the rules. No shadows or rounded corners apart from the circular buttons.

Arms Intervention

Participants will receive AAA817 infusion directly into a vein with ARPIs.

Participants will receive standard treatment as decided by the trial doctor either as a chemotherapy infusion directly into a vein, ARPI either as capsules or tablets or [177Lu]Lu-PSMA-617 (AAA617) infusion directly into a vein.

Indication
post Lu Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer
Phase
Phase 2/3
Patients
443
Primary Outcome Measures
1) Biochemical response rate (Phase II): Biochemical response rate as defined as the percentage of participants who achieved a ≥ 50% decrease from baseline that is confirmed by a second measurement
2) Adverse Events (AEs) and Serious Adverse Events (SAEs), and deaths - Phase II: Safety defined as the type, incidence and severity of AEs and SAEs, and deaths
3) Tolerability of the proposed dose of AAA817- Phase II: Percentage of participants who experienced Dose interruptions, reductions, discontinuation, dose intensity and duration of exposure
4) Radiographic progression-free survival (rPFS)- Phase III: Percentage of participants who are alive without radiographic progression or who are lost to follow-up at the time of analysis
5) Overall survival (OS)- Phase III: Percentage of participants who are alive or who are lost to follow-up at the time of analysis
Arms Intervention
Experimental: Phase II: AAA817 Dose A
AAA817 Dose A will be given for a number of cycles: a cycle = 8 weeks
Experimental: Phase II: AAA817 Dose B
AAA817 will be given for a number of cycles; a cycle = 8 weeks
Experimental: Phase III: Recommended Phase 3 Dose of AAA817
Rp3D of AAA817 will be given for a number of cycles; a cycle = 8 weeks
Active Comparator: Phase III: Investigator's choice of SoC
Participants will be given Standard of Care (SOC) treatment per Investigator's choice.
Target Patients
Adults with PSMA Positive Metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer Who Have Disease Progressed on or After [177Lu]Lu-PSMA Targeted Therapy
Readout Milestone(s)
2028
Publication
TBD

**Layout**

Left navigation sidebar about 13% wide with back/forward arrows at top, a 'Content' heading and a vertical menu with the Appendix section highlighted. The main area has a left-aligned title at top, then a two-column table (bold labels, regular values) starting at about x 17%, ending at about x 55%. The Novartis logo sits bottom-left of the main area; the footer text and slide number sit bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Two small circular outline icons with left and right arrows at top-left of the sidebar. A vertical gradient strip at the far left edge beside the Appendix menu block, running from pale lavender at the top to orange at the bottom. A thin orange rule under the table header. Thin light grey horizontal separator lines between table rows. Novartis logo: a flame-like swirl symbol with the serif wordmark NOVARTIS in dark grey. A very light grey panel behind the Appendix submenu. A thin vertical divider line separates the sidebar from the main area.

**Design**

Background: Solid off-white #FCFCFC. Off-white background #FCFCFC with the sidebar in the same tone. The Appendix block has a light grey #F5F5F5 panel. Title and table labels are bold Arial in near-black #161616. Body values are regular Arial in black. The sidebar uses Volta Modern, a geometric sans-serif, in black, medium weight for active items and roman for the rest. The orange accent is about #F26B38 and the lavender is about #D5D8EE. Title is about 2.5% of slide height and table text about 1.4%. No shadows or rounded corners.
